subject: Missing logistics details — Saturday Panel 2
body:
Hi Margaret,

Could you send a short bio (120 words max), headshot, allergies or dietary restrictions (or “none”), Friday speaker breakfast RSVP, AV needs (or “none”), and your Boston-area arrival date and time? The April 13, 11:59 PM deadline has passed, so please reply as soon as you can. Friday’s breakfast is 9:30–10:30 AM at Dunmore Hall Dining Room (3 Quincy Walk, Cambridge).

As Panel 2 moderator, please check in Saturday, April 17 at 8:30 AM at Larkin Auditorium (14 Hollis Lane, Cambridge); the bilingual session runs 9:00–10:00 AM.

Thanks,
Antara Conference Team
